gap_description:
create a System Monitor Tool called system_monitor.py Gap: Limited system visibility (only logs via query_service_logs) Actions:

cpu_usage - Current CPU usage %
memory_usage - RAM usage stats
disk_usage - Disk space per mount
process_list - List running processes
network_stats - Network I/O statistics
system_uptime - System uptime
Libraries: psutil as an example, cover many possible system monitoring needs
purpose: Provides detailed system visibility beyond just service logs - monitors hardware resources, processes, and system health in real-time
capabilities: cpu_usage - Current CPU usage percentage and per-core stats
memory_usage - RAM usage stats (total, used, available, percent)
disk_usage - Disk space statistics per mount point
process_list - List running processes with CPU/memory usage
system_uptime - System uptime and boot time
all - Get all system stats at once

parameters.limit: For process_list: number of processes to return (default: 10)
